When a player reveals that character to take his turn, you immediately take all of his gold. Their buildings cannot be destroyed by the Warlord, unless they are killed by the Assassin., Magician (order 3): Can either exchange their hand with another player's, or discard any number of district cards face down to the bottom of the deck and draw an equal number of cards from the district deck (can only do this once per turn)., Warlord (order 8): Gains one gold for each red (military) district in their city., King (order 4): Gains one gold for each yellow (noble) district in their city. They receive the crown token and will be the first to choose characters on the next round., Architect (order 7): Gains two extra district cards. Can build up to 3 districts per turn., Assassin (order 1): Select another character whom you wish to kill. The killed character loses their turn., Mechant (order 6): Gains one gold for each green (trade) district in their city. Gains one extra gold.]>
